### Shore Bancshares, Inc. Reports Quarterly Dividend of $0.14 Per Share


08/20/2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s205.q4cdn.com/356257700/files/doc_news/Shore-Bancshares-Inc--Reports-Quarterly-Dividend-of-0-14-Per-Share-2026.pdf)


EASTON, Md.


, Aug. 20, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Shore Bancshares, Inc. (Nasdaq: SHBI), the parent company of Shore United Bank, N.A. announced today that its Board of Directors has declared a quarterly common stock dividend of $0.14 per share, payable on September 16, 2026, to holders of record at the close of business on September 2, 2026.


**Shore Bancshares Information**


Shore Bancshares is a financial holding company headquartered in Easton, Maryland and is the parent company of Shore United Bank, N.A. Shore Bancshares engages in trust and wealth management services through Wye Financial Partners, a division of Shore United Bank, N.A. Additional information is available at[www.shorebancshares.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4756779-1&h=4194597177&u=https%3A%2F%2Fedge.prnewswire.com%2Fc%2Flink%2F%3Ft%3D0%26l%3Den%26o%3D4622679-1%26h%3D1712648751%26u%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fwww.shorebancshares.com%252F%26a%3Dwww.shorebancshares.com&a=www.shorebancshares.com) .
